fantasyhub.kabuto.requirements: Kabuto: check form, belt, energy, level and aimed target.

fantasyhub.rider.upkeep_failed: Stance ended: insufficient Mana or Stamina.
fantasyhub.rider.description.ryuki_strik: Punch and fire an explosive dragon projectile.
fantasyhub.rider.description.ryuki_sword: Two diagonal slashes apply Burning Bleed.
fantasyhub.rider.description.ryuki_guard: Two orbiting shields absorb damage and reflect 25% of eligible melee damage as fire.
fantasyhub.rider.description.ryuki_adven: Summon Dragreder for a spiral attack and sustained fire damage.
fantasyhub.rider.description.ryuki_survi: Toggle Survive until switched off. +20% damage and movement speed. Optional upkeep is server-configured.
fantasyhub.rider.description.ryuki_shoot: Fire missiles at an area. Hits slow enemies by 50% and reduce healing.
fantasyhub.rider.description.ryuki_final: Charge a crest, leap and deliver an explosive Rider Kick.
fantasyhub.rider.description.knight_swor: Dash and thrust with armor penetration and 35% slow.
fantasyhub.rider.description.knight_nast: Darkwing releases a cone wave: 1.5 seconds of Stun and 3 seconds of Blindness.
fantasyhub.rider.description.knight_tric: Three temporary shadows attack; Knight becomes invisible for 2.5 seconds.
fantasyhub.rider.description.knight_guar: Wrap in bat wings, reduce damage by 80% for 2 seconds and repel nearby enemies.
fantasyhub.rider.description.knight_surv: Toggle Survive: capped attack speed, lifesteal and 20% cooldown reduction. No fixed expiry.
fantasyhub.rider.description.knight_blas: Move with a dark tornado that pulls enemies and strikes repeatedly.
fantasyhub.rider.description.knight_fina: Charge an aerial drill kick and strike the landing area.
fantasyhub.rider.description.decade_slas: Three slashes. Recast during the short window to retreat and fire four bullets without a second resource cost.
fantasyhub.rider.description.decade_illu: Two Decade projections fire beside you. Each of the three attackers has one validated shot.
fantasyhub.rider.description.decade_cloc: Hide for 1.5 seconds, move safely behind the target and strike critically. Solid blocks stop the path.
fantasyhub.rider.description.decade_heis: Recast within 2 seconds to select Kuuga Shield → Faiz Speed → Ryuki Flame. Selection keeps the original cooldown and resource cost.
fantasyhub.rider.description.decade_comp: Toggle +30% damage and control immunity. Cards orbit the unchanged Decade model.
fantasyhub.rider.description.decade_ulti: Requires Complete. Rotates Kuuga Ultimate → Blade King → Kiva Emperor; each projection performs its own attack and disappears.
fantasyhub.rider.description.decade_dime: Requires Complete. Form seven 3D cards, rush through them and deal True Damage along the safe collision path.
fantasyhub.rider.description.ryuki_strik: Drag Visor-Z fires three independently colliding explosive projectiles.
fantasyhub.rider.description.ryuki_sword: Dash through enemies with a purple-red slash that penetrates 50% armor.
fantasyhub.rider.description.ryuki_final: Dragranzer charges across a bounded dragon-flame corridor.
fantasyhub.rider.description.knight_swor: Dual blades dash through the target twice, with two independent validated hits.
fantasyhub.rider.description.knight_fina: Shippu Ranbu: Darkwing and Knight rush through a straight line with shadow trails.
fantasyhub.rider.passive.knight: Dark Echolocation: strike from behind or exploit Blindness/Stun
fantasyhub.rider.passive.decade: Passing-by Rider: next attack launches three cards
fantasyhub.rider.passive.ryuki.descripti: Drag-Resonance: at ten stacks restore 5% maximum Mana and trigger a fire explosion. Survive grants extra fire projectiles and nearby Burning.
fantasyhub.hero.description.spider_man_w: Dash through up to three distinct foes; each hit causes bleeding and slows.
Swing in an arc and slam the actual landing point, knocking nearby enemies upward.
Fire eight web shots. Hits stack movement and attack slow; the last shot blinds.
fantasyhub.hero.description.spider_man_c: Cocoon and stun a target. Recast within three seconds to slam it for area damage.
fantasyhub.hero.description.spider_man_a: Lift the target and strike five times while both fighters remain airborne.
fantasyhub.hero.description.spider_man_w: Reduce incoming damage by 90% for two seconds. A melee hit triggers one evasive counter and root.
Trap and blind the area, unleash six slashes, then detonate the web with true damage.
fantasyhub.hero.description.sorcerer_sup: Strike with an eldritch whip; recast within two seconds to pull and slow the same target.
Conjure two mandalas for three seconds. Block 70% of frontal damage and reflect a magic bolt.
Create a mirror zone for three seconds; damage enemies, seal mobility skills and reverse projectiles.
Leave an invulnerable body while your astral self flies for 3.5 seconds; return and recover 15% Mana.
Open linked portals for six seconds. Allies pass safely; enemies take damage and are stunned.
Create eight magical images that bind, silence and damage enemies at their center.
Freeze the area, bind enemies with Crimson Bands, then shatter time with true magic damage.
fantasyhub.hero.description.iron_man_rep: Fire a palm repulsor and knock the target back; firing while airborne also recoils the suit.
fantasyhub.hero.description.iron_man_mic: Launch twelve guided missiles into the designated area; explosions slow their victims.
fantasyhub.hero.description.iron_man_tar: Cross two targeting lasers, reduce armor and burn for 5% maximum Health over three seconds.
fantasyhub.hero.description.iron_man_thr: Dash six blocks, remove slows and gain a three-second shield plus damage reduction.
fantasyhub.hero.description.iron_man_uni: Charge for 0.8 seconds, then pierce enemies along an 18-block chest beam.
fantasyhub.hero.description.iron_man_hou: Call two orbiting sentries for eight seconds. They fire independently and provide 10% damage reduction.
fantasyhub.hero.description.iron_man_orb: Lock an area, fire an orbital true-damage beam, destroy shields and apply an EMP silence.
fantasyhub.hero.description.thor_mjolnir: Throw Mjolnir outward, stun at the endpoint and strike again on its slowing return path.
fantasyhub.hero.description.thor_thunder: Leap and slam with thunder, damaging and launching enemies around the landing point.
fantasyhub.hero.description.thor_lightni: Spin Stormbreaker for two seconds, repeatedly strike nearby enemies and intercept incoming projectiles.
fantasyhub.hero.description.thor_stormbr: Release a lightning cleave that penetrates 50% armor, leaving a three-second charged trail.
fantasyhub.hero.description.thor_bifrost: Call Bifrost: cleanse and shield allies while damaging and repelling enemies.
fantasyhub.hero.description.thor_god_of_: Awaken for ten seconds: gain damage, attack speed, chain lightning and faster Stormbreaker abilities.
fantasyhub.hero.description.thor_bring_m: Leap into a thunderous true-damage impact, followed by four lightning strikes across the area.
fantasyhub.hero.description.flash_super_: Toggle Super-Speed and Jump Boost III; consumes two Speed Force each second until switched off.
fantasyhub.hero.description.flash_slow_m: Slow nearby enemies and their attacks for three seconds; player slows respect the PvP cap.
fantasyhub.hero.description.flash_lightn: Throw lightning that stuns its first victim and chains to up to two nearby foes.
fantasyhub.hero.description.flash_wind_f: Form a damaging vacuum tornado that pulls enemies inward and finally launches them upward.
fantasyhub.hero.description.flash_molecu: Phase through bounded, loaded terrain for two seconds and evade ordinary physical melee hits.
fantasyhub.hero.description.flash_speed_: Cleanse debuffs and steal 30% movement speed from the nearest enemy for five seconds.
fantasyhub.hero.description.flash_infini: Charge the area, briefly freeze foes, then dash into a true-damage punch and shockwave.
fantasyhub.hero.description.batman_batar: Throw three slowing Batarangs. Recast within two seconds for an explosive interrupting Batarang.
fantasyhub.hero.description.batman_batcl: Grapple a foe to pull, stun and weaken armor; grapple terrain to travel toward the anchor.
fantasyhub.hero.description.batman_smoke: Blind and silence enemies in smoke; become invisible and empower the next normal hit to 250%.
fantasyhub.hero.description.batman_detec: Reveal enemies through walls for six seconds and expose them to 20% more incoming damage.
fantasyhub.hero.description.batman_disru: Disrupt a selected enemy, silence its skills and destroy defensive shields.
fantasyhub.hero.description.batman_cape_: Sweep a frontal half-circle with the cape, stun foes and strike four times, finishing with a launch.
fantasyhub.hero.description.batman_batwi: Mark and silence an area, call a Batwing bombardment, then stun and scatter surviving enemies.
fantasyhub.flight.requirements.thor: Flight: Thor class + Thor chestplate, leggings, boots + Thor cape in Back.
fantasyhub.flight.requirements.sorcerer_: Flight: Sorcerer Supreme class + Cloak of Levitation in Back.
fantasyhub.flight.enabled: Flight enabled · Double-tap Jump to land
fantasyhub.flight.control: Back slot · Double-tap Jump to toggle flight
fantasyhub.glide.requirements.batman: Batman class + cape in Back. Hold Jump while falling to glide; release to stop.

item.fantasyhub.space_stone.hint: Right-click: blink behind a player (15m) or portal forward.
item.fantasyhub.power_stone.hint: Holding/equipped: Strength II + Resistance II. Right-click: 6m cosmic blast.
item.fantasyhub.reality_stone.hint: Holding/equipped: instant saplings, Fortune III on ores, rare spawn weight. Right-click: heal/feed allies.
item.fantasyhub.mind_stone.hint: Right-click: freeze the target for 3 seconds.
item.fantasyhub.soul_stone.hint: Holding/equipped: hostile mobs and Pokémon leave you alone. Right-click: 5 seconds invulnerability.
item.fantasyhub.time_stone.hint: Possessing: revive at 50% HP/hunger. Right-click: freeze enemies in 10m for 5 seconds.
item.fantasyhub.infinity_gauntlet.hint: Sprint + right-click: cycle stone. Right-click: use selected stone. Sneak + right-click: SNAP (all six stones; 30min cooldown).

fantasyhub.commerce.offer.personal_elite: Starts an elite personal encounter in a reserved personal arena. Infinity drop chances remain unchanged.
